if not month:
            raise ValueError("budget check needs a month scope: an empty month matches every record")
        budgets = self._store.select(self.ENTITY, [])
        match = [record for record in budgets
                 if record.get('category_id') == category_id
                 and record.get('month') == month]
        if not match:
            return False
        limit = match[0].get('amount_limit_cents')
        spent = 0
        for record in self._store.select('Expense', []):
            if record.get('category_id') != category_id:
                continue
            expense_date_str = str(record.get('expense_date') or '')
            if not expense_date_str:
                continue
            date_key = expense_date_str[:10]
            if not date_key.startswith(month):
                continue
            spent += record.get('amount_cents') or 0
        return spent > limit if limit is not None else False

year = year or datetime.datetime.now().year
    year_str = str(year)
    monthly_totals = self._repos['ExpenseRepository'].get_yearly_spending_summary(year=year_str)
    total_spent = sum(monthly_totals.values())
    category_spending = {}
    # Aggregate category spending by category_id across the year
    for month, total in monthly_totals.items():
        month_start = month[:7] + '-01'
        month_end = month[:7] + '-31'
        expenses = self._repos['ExpenseRepository'].get_expenses_by_date_range(start_date=month_start, end_date=month_end)
        for expense in expenses:
            category_id = expense.category_id
            if category_id not in category_spending:
                category_spending[category_id] = 0
            category_spending[category_id] += expense.amount_cents or 0
    
    # Get category names for display
    category_names = {}
    for cat in self._repos['CategoryRepository'].read_all():
        category_names[cat.id] = cat.name
    
    # Build result with required keys
    result = {
        'total_spent': total_spent,
        'monthly_totals': monthly_totals,
        'top_spending_categories': sorted(
            [(k, category_names.get(k, 'Unknown')) for k in category_spending.keys()],
            key=lambda x: x[1] if isinstance(x[1], str) else 0,
            reverse=True
        ),
        'category_spending': [(cat_id, amount) for cat_id, amount in category_spending.items()]
    }
    return result
